Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 18 October 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bataan, Tarlac and Zambales within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Laguna, Rizal, Metro Manila, Batangas, Cavite, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija(Gapan, General Tinio, Gabaldon, Laur, Bongabon, Cabiao, San Isidro) and Pampanga(Candaba, Masantol, Apalit, San Simon, San Luis, Macabebe, Arayat) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
